title: Complaint (composed)
description: Generated by 08-tools/build-schemas.ts from the raw schema plus registered extensions. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: node 08-tools/build-schemas.ts
x-docIdRule: The Firestore document id is the complaint id. The id field MIRRORS it. It is not a second id. It exists because both the user app and the admin panel keep the id inside the document they hold in memory, and a round-trip shape must survive a write and a read.
x-writes: platform functions: mergedInto, escalationLevel, assignedAt, escalatedAt, escalatedTo, autoResolveDeadline, citizenVerified*, reopened*
x-reads: userapp: own only, scoped by the deviceId claim
driverapp: wards in the current trip only
adminpanel: within the live staff ward scope
x-no-pii: This collection holds NO phone number. Neither the citizen's nor the staff member's. A raw phone in a complaint is readable by every staff member who can read the complaint, because a Firestore read returns the whole document and the rules cannot redact a field. The raw phone lives in staffPhones/{code}. CHG-0012.

id.description: A copy of the Firestore document id. It MUST equal the document id. Both the user app and the admin panel read it.

deviceId.description: The citizen's install id. THEIR ONLY KEY. The read rule compares it against the deviceId claim. Never a client parameter.

photoUrl.description: Storage path complaints/{complaintId}/photo.jpg. Compressed under 500 KB.

phoneMasked.description: The MASKED complainant phone, shape PHONE_MASK_FORMAT, 98XXXXXX10. Ten characters, six of them X. The raw phone lives in complaintPhones/{complaintId}. A Firestore read returns the whole document and the rules cannot redact a field, so a raw phone here would reach every staff member who can read the complaint. CHG-0012.

location.description: Where the citizen saw the problem.

createdAt.description: A SERVER timestamp. The complaint's age drives escalation, so a client clock would break escalation.

assignedTo.description: The staff doc id this complaint is assigned to. The staff NAME is read from staff/{assignedTo}. It is never copied into the complaint.

assignedAt.description: A SERVER timestamp. Set when status becomes assigned.

escalatedTo.description: The staff doc id this complaint was escalated to. The staff NAME is read from staff/{escalatedTo}. It is never copied into the complaint.

escalatedAt.description: A SERVER timestamp. Set when escalationLevel rises.

resolvedPhotoUrl.description: Storage path complaints/{complaintId}/resolved.jpg. The cleaning proof photo.

autoResolveDeadline.description: A SERVER timestamp. Set when the office resolves a complaint and the citizen is asked to verify. The autoResolvePendingComplaints schedule closes the complaint after this instant. Null means no verification was asked for.

citizenVerifiedAt.description: A SERVER timestamp. When the citizen answered the verification request.

citizenVerifiedStatus.title: Citizen verification outcome
citizenVerifiedStatus.description: What the citizen said. confirmed accepts the resolution. rejected reopens it.

citizenRejectReason.description: Why the citizen rejected the resolution. Free text from the citizen.

citizenRejectPhotoUrl.description: Storage path complaints/{complaintId}/reject.jpg. The citizen's proof that the work was not done.

reopenedAt.description: A SERVER timestamp. When the complaint was reopened.

reopenReason.description: Why the complaint was reopened. Free text from the citizen.

reopenPhotoUrl.description: Storage path complaints/{complaintId}/reopen.jpg. The citizen's proof.

mergedInto.description: The ticket this one was merged into. Null normally. Set by mergeDuplicates.

note.description: Free text from the office. This is the only note field. The office's cleaning note and the citizen's reason are separate fields.
